h-pm.title: Prediction markets
h-pm.body: Every open market on Polymarket and Kalshi, beside the record of markets like it: how often markets at this price, this far from closing, in this category actually resolved yes.

run.title: Read the board
run.body: Pick a venue, a category and a minimum volume, then read the board. Open markets are kept for fifteen minutes; Refresh fetches both venues again.

minn.title: Resolved markets behind a read
minn.body: How many past markets like this one must have resolved before the board gives a read. A higher number means fewer reads. Too few in the category, and it reads every category instead, marked all.

t-gap.title: Largest gap
t-gap.body: The biggest difference on the board between a market's price and how often markets like it resolved yes. A gap is the crowd's past habit, not a forecast for this market.

tbl.title: The board
tbl.body: Price: the crowd's price for yes. Resolved yes, like it: how often past markets in that price band resolved yes, out of N. Average return: what buying yes at those prices returned, before fees and spread.
